name_reason: Name follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. 'cast_spell_0e' encodes spell_id 0xE (14), a meaningful FD2 spell ID (range 00h-23h) and the literal passed to fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast, NOT an address residue. 'variant_b' matches the heal/buff dispatch family (siblings 0xD/0xF/0x10 all use _variant_b, worker is fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast). Dispatch table @ 0x51D39 holds this function's address, confirming the id-0xE role.
purpose: Spell dispatch handler for spell_id 0xE: a thin variant-B (heal/buff) wrapper that plays status-effect SFX + a slide pre-cast effect, then delegates to the variant-B heal dispatch worker.
logic_summary: 1) __CHK(0x14) stack-probe prologue. 2) fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(data_fd2_audio_status_effect_sfx_handle_ptr, 0xB, 1) plays status-effect SFX id 0xB. 3) fd2_play_variant_b_slide_pre_effect(2, 4) runs the slide pre-cast animation with params {2,4} (stronger than sibling 0xD's {1,2}). 4) tail-call fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast(caster, 0xE, n_tgt, tgt_arr). In the vendor binary the tail is a JMP into 0x21AD9 (the 0xD sibling) shared epilogue at 0x21B0B (PUSH caster; CALL fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast @ 0x21B18; ADD ESP,0x10; RET); the rebuilt C models this identical-epilogue tail-merge as a plain call (functionally equivalent, codegen-only distinction).
signature: void fd2_cast_spell_0e_variant_b(int caster, int n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Casting unit id; forwarded as 1st arg to fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast.
params.reason: Clear and consistent with the whole spell-handler family; no address residue.

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of targets; forwarded as 3rd arg (num_targets) to the dispatch worker.
params.reason: Clear and consistent with siblings; no address residue.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the target-id array; cast to int and forwarded as 4th arg (target_id_array) to the dispatch worker.
params.reason: Clear and consistent with siblings; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; vendor binary exits via JMP-to-shared-tail (no explicit RET of its own), the shared tail RETs.

comment_original_issue: Function had no individual comment block; only the family header (lines 120-124) covered it, while sibling 0xD has a per-function one-liner. The 0xE-specific distinguishing detail (slide pre-effect params {2,4}, spell_id, address) was undocumented.
notes: Disassembly (0x21B99..0x21BCB) matches src and plate exactly: PUSH 0x14;CALL __CHK; sfx(handle@0x53B13,0xB,1); slide_pre_effect(2,4); PUSH tgt_arr;PUSH n_tgt;PUSH 0xE;JMP 0x21B0B. Dispatch table @ 0x51D39 = 0x00021B99 (this fn), next entry 0x0002211C (id 0xF). Ghidra signature uses (int,int,int) param types; src uses (int,int,uint8*) which is the documented home declaration -- type difference is the established src convention for this family and out of scope (no signature/type changes this stage). Plate is more verbose than src comment but fully consistent -> left unchanged.
